    45	class VQLayer(nn.Module):
    46	    """Trainable vector quantizer from RecBole3.0."""
    47	
    48	    def __init__(
    49	        self,
    50	        codebook_size: int,
    51	        codebook_dim: int,
    52	        beta: float = 0.25,
    53	        sk_epsilon: float = -1.0,
    54	        sk_iters: int = -1,
    55	    ):
    56	        super().__init__()
    57	        self.dim = int(codebook_dim)
    58	        self.n_embed = int(codebook_size)
    59	        self.beta = float(beta)
    60	        self.use_sk = sk_epsilon > 0 and sk_iters > 0
    61	        self.sk_epsilon = float(sk_epsilon)
    62	        self.sk_iters = int(sk_iters)
    63	        self.embed = nn.Embedding(self.n_embed, self.dim)
    64	
    65	    def get_code_embs(self) -> nn.Parameter:
    66	        return self.embed.weight
    67	
    68	    def _copy_init_embed(self, init_embed: torch.Tensor) -> None:
    69	        self.embed.weight.data.copy_(init_embed)
    70	
    71	    @staticmethod
    72	    def center_distance(distances: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    73	        max_distance = distances.max()
    74	        min_distance = distances.min()
    75	        middle = (max_distance + min_distance) / 2
    76	        amplitude = max_distance - middle + 1e-5
    77	        if not bool(amplitude > 0):
    78	            raise ValueError("Cannot center a constant distance matrix.")
    79	        return (distances - middle) / amplitude
    80	
    81	    @torch.no_grad()
    82	    def sinkhorn(
    83	        self,
    84	        distances: torch.Tensor,
    85	        epsilon: float = 0.003,
    86	        iterations: int = 5,
    87	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
    88	        q = torch.exp(-distances / epsilon)
    89	        batch_size, codebook_size = q.shape
    90	        q /= q.sum(-1, keepdim=True).sum(-2, keepdim=True)
    91	        for _ in range(iterations):
    92	            q /= q.sum(0, keepdim=True)
    93	            q /= codebook_size
    94	            q /= q.sum(1, keepdim=True)
    95	            q /= batch_size
    96	        q *= batch_size
    97	        return q
    98	
    99	    def _distances(self, latent: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   100	        code_embs = self.get_code_embs()
   101	        return (
   102	            latent.pow(2).sum(1, keepdim=True)
   103	            - 2 * latent @ code_embs.t()
   104	            + code_embs.pow(2).sum(1, keepdim=True).t()
   105	        )

   107	    def _indices(self, distances: torch.Tensor, infer_use_sk: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
   108	        if (self.training and self.use_sk) or (self.use_sk and infer_use_sk):
   109	            centered = self.center_distance(distances).double()
   110	            q = self.sinkhorn(centered, self.sk_epsilon, self.sk_iters)
   111	            if torch.isnan(q).any() or torch.isinf(q).any():
   112	                raise RuntimeError("Sinkhorn assignment returned NaN or infinity.")
   113	            return torch.argmax(q, dim=-1)
   114	        return torch.argmin(distances, dim=-1)

   116	    def forward(
   117	        self,
   118	        x: torch.Tensor,
   119	        infer_use_sk: bool = False,
   120	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, int, torch.Tensor]:
   121	        latent = x.view(-1, self.dim)
   122	        embed_ind = self._indices(self._distances(latent), infer_use_sk)
   123	        onehot = F.one_hot(embed_ind, self.n_embed)
   124	        used = onehot.sum(0)
   125	        # Skip the DDP all_reduce when running inference on rank 0 only:
   126	        # the unused-code accounting is a per-rank stat, and a single-rank
   127	        # all_reduce would deadlock waiting for the other 3 ranks to join.
   128	        if distributed.is_initialized() and infer_use_sk is False and not getattr(self, "_skip_ddp_reduce", False):

   130	        unused_codes = int((used == 0).sum().item())

   132	        x_q = F.embedding(embed_ind, self.get_code_embs()).view(x.shape)
   133	        quant_loss = F.mse_loss(x_q, x.detach()) + self.beta * F.mse_loss(x, x_q.detach())
   134	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()
   135	        return x_q, quant_loss, unused_codes, embed_ind.view(*x.shape[:-1])
   136	
   137	    def embed_code(self, embed_id: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   138	        return F.embedding(embed_id, self.get_code_embs())
   139	
   140	    def init_codebook(self, x: torch.Tensor, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
   141	        kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=self.n_embed, n_init="auto").fit(x.detach().cpu().numpy())
   142	        centers = torch.tensor(kmeans.cluster_centers_, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
   143	        if distributed.is_initialized():
   144	            distributed.broadcast(centers, 0)
   145	        self._copy_init_embed(centers.clone())
   146	        embed_ind = torch.argmin(self._distances(x), dim=-1).view(*x.shape[:-1])
   147	        return x - self.embed_code(embed_ind)

   150	class EMAVQLayer(VQLayer):
   151	    """EMA variant from RecBole3.0."""
   152	
   153	    def __init__(
   154	        self,
   155	        codebook_size: int,
   156	        codebook_dim: int,
   157	        beta: float = 0.25,
   158	        sk_epsilon: float = -1.0,
   159	        sk_iters: int = -1,

   161	        eps: float = 1e-5,

   164	        self.decay = float(decay)
   165	        self.eps = float(eps)
   166	        embed = torch.zeros(self.n_embed, self.dim)
   167	        self.embed = nn.Parameter(embed, requires_grad=False)
   168	        nn.init.xavier_normal_(self.embed)
   169	        self.register_buffer("embed_avg", embed.clone())
   170	        self.register_buffer("cluster_size", torch.ones(self.n_embed))
   171	
   172	    def _copy_init_embed(self, init_embed: torch.Tensor) -> None:
   173	        self.embed.data.copy_(init_embed)
   174	        self.embed_avg.data.copy_(init_embed)
   175	        self.cluster_size.data.copy_(torch.ones(self.n_embed, device=init_embed.device))
   176	
   177	    def get_code_embs(self) -> nn.Parameter:
   178	        return self.embed
   179	
   180	    def forward(
   181	        self,
   182	        x: torch.Tensor,
   183	        infer_use_sk: bool = False,
   184	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, int, torch.Tensor]:
   185	        latent = x.view(-1, self.dim)
   186	        embed_ind = self._indices(self._distances(latent), infer_use_sk)
   187	        x_q = F.embedding(embed_ind, self.get_code_embs()).view(x.shape)
   188	
   189	        if self.training:
   190	            onehot = F.one_hot(embed_ind, self.n_embed).type(latent.dtype)
   191	            used = onehot.sum(0)
   192	            embed_sum = onehot.t() @ latent
   193	            if distributed.is_initialized():
   194	                distributed.all_reduce(used, op=distributed.ReduceOp.SUM)
   195	                distributed.all_reduce(embed_sum, op=distributed.ReduceOp.SUM)
   196	            unused_codes = int((used == 0).sum().item())
   197	            self.cluster_size.data.mul_(self.decay).add_(used, alpha=1 - self.decay)
   198	            self.embed_avg.data.mul_(self.decay).add_(embed_sum, alpha=1 - self.decay)
   199	            n = self.cluster_size.sum()
   200	            norm_w = n * (self.cluster_size + self.eps) / (n + self.n_embed * self.eps)
   201	            self.embed.data.copy_(self.embed_avg / norm_w.unsqueeze(1))
   202	        else:
   203	            used = F.one_hot(embed_ind, self.n_embed).sum(0)
   204	            if distributed.is_initialized():
   205	                distributed.all_reduce(used, op=distributed.ReduceOp.SUM)
   206	            unused_codes = int((used == 0).sum().item())
   207	
   208	        quant_loss = self.beta * F.mse_loss(x, x_q.detach())
   209	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()
   210	        return x_q, quant_loss, unused_codes, embed_ind.view(*x.shape[:-1])

   239	class RQLayer(nn.Module):
   240	    """Residual stack matching RecBole3.0's RQLayer."""
   241	
   242	    def __init__(self, config: Any):
   243	        super().__init__()
   244	        self.config = config
   245	        self.codebook_num = int(config.codebook_num)
   246	        self.codebook_dim = int(config.codebook_dim)
   247	        if isinstance(config.codebook_size, int):
   248	            sizes = [int(config.codebook_size)] * self.codebook_num
   249	        else:
   250	            sizes = [int(size) for size in config.codebook_size]
   251	            if len(sizes) != self.codebook_num:
   252	                raise ValueError("codebook_size must have one entry per quantization level")
   253	        self.codebook_sizes = sizes
   254	        self.vq_type = str(config.vq_type)
   255	        self.vq_beta = float(config.beta)
   256	        self.branch_enabled = True
   257	        self.curved_enabled = True
   258	        self.curvature = 1.0
   259	        self.branch_eta = 0.05
   260	        self.branch_projection = nn.Linear(int(config.branch_dim), self.codebook_dim, bias=False) if getattr(config, "branch_dim", 0) else None
   261	        self.sk_epsilon = float(config.sk_epsilon)
   262	        self.sk_iters = int(config.sk_iters)
   263	
   264	        layers: list[nn.Module] = []
   265	        for level, size in enumerate(self.codebook_sizes):
   266	            epsilon = self.sk_epsilon if level == self.codebook_num - 1 else -1.0
   267	            iterations = self.sk_iters if level == self.codebook_num - 1 else -1
   268	            if self.vq_type == "vq":
   269	                layer = VQLayer(size, self.codebook_dim, self.vq_beta, epsilon, iterations)
   270	            elif self.vq_type == "ema":
   271	                layer = EMAVQLayer(size, self.codebook_dim, self.vq_beta, epsilon, iterations, config.ema_decay)
   272	            elif self.vq_type == "simvq":
   273	                layer = SimVQLayer(size, self.codebook_dim, self.vq_beta, epsilon, iterations, config.fix_code_embs)
   274	            else:
   275	                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported vq_type: {self.vq_type}")
   276	            layers.append(layer)
   277	        self.vq_layers = nn.ModuleList(layers)
   278	
   279	    def forward(
   280	        self,
   281	        x: torch.Tensor,
   282	        infer_use_sk: bool = False,
   283	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, float, torch.Tensor]:
   284	        quantized_x = torch.zeros(x.shape[0], self.codebook_dim, device=x.device)
   285	        sum_quant_loss: torch.Tensor | float = 0.0
   286	        num_unused_codes = 0.0
   287	        output = torch.empty(x.shape[0], self.codebook_num, dtype=torch.long, device=x.device)
   288	        residual = x
   289	        branch = getattr(self, "_branch_batch", None)
   290	        for level, vq_layer in enumerate(self.vq_layers):
   291	            target = residual
   292	            if branch is not None and self.branch_enabled:
   293	                direction = F.normalize(self.branch_projection(branch), dim=-1, eps=1e-8)
   294	                if self.curved_enabled:
   295	                    c = self.curvature
   296	                    target = logmap0(mobius_add(expmap0(residual, c), expmap0(self.branch_eta * direction, c), c), c)
   297	                else:
   298	                    target = residual + self.branch_eta * direction
   299	            if branch is not None and self.curved_enabled and self.branch_enabled:
   300	                # Use curved-selected codes for both the loss and ST output.
   301	                c = self.curvature
   302	                xh = expmap0(target, c)
   303	                ch = expmap0(vq_layer.get_code_embs(), c)
   304	                distances = poincare_distance(xh[:, None, :], ch[None, :, :], c).squeeze(-1).square()
   305	                indices = torch.argmin(distances, dim=-1)
   306	                onehot = F.one_hot(indices, vq_layer.n_embed).to(target.dtype)
   307	                quantized = onehot @ vq_layer.get_code_embs()
   308	                used = onehot.sum(0)
   309	                if distributed.is_initialized() and not getattr(vq_layer, "_skip_ddp_reduce", False):
   310	                    distributed.all_reduce(used, op=distributed.ReduceOp.SUM)
   311	                unused = int((used == 0).sum().item())
   312	                quant_loss = F.mse_loss(quantized, target.detach()) + vq_layer.beta * F.mse_loss(target, quantized.detach())
   313	                quant = target + (quantized - target).detach()
   314	            else:
   315	                quant, quant_loss, unused, indices = vq_layer(target, infer_use_sk)
   316	            residual = residual - quant
   317	            quantized_x = quantized_x + quant
   318	            sum_quant_loss = sum_quant_loss + quant_loss
   319	            num_unused_codes += unused
   320	            output[:, level] = indices
   321	        return quantized_x, sum_quant_loss / self.codebook_num, num_unused_codes, output
   322	
   323	    def init_codebook(self, x: torch.Tensor, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
   324	        residual = x
   325	        for vq_layer in self.vq_layers:
   326	            residual = vq_layer.init_codebook(residual, device)
   327	        return residual

    48	    def __init__(
    49	        self,

    54	        sk_iters: int = -1,

    59	        self.beta = float(beta)
    60	        self.use_sk = sk_epsilon > 0 and sk_iters > 0

    71	    @staticmethod
    72	    def center_distance(distances: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    73	        max_distance = distances.max()
    74	        min_distance = distances.min()
    75	        middle = (max_distance + min_distance) / 2
    76	        amplitude = max_distance - middle + 1e-5
    77	        if not bool(amplitude > 0):
    78	            raise ValueError("Cannot center a constant distance matrix.")
    79	        return (distances - middle) / amplitude
    80	
    81	    @torch.no_grad()
    82	    def sinkhorn(
    83	        self,
    84	        distances: torch.Tensor,
    85	        epsilon: float = 0.003,
    86	        iterations: int = 5,
    87	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
    88	        q = torch.exp(-distances / epsilon)
    89	        batch_size, codebook_size = q.shape
    90	        q /= q.sum(-1, keepdim=True).sum(-2, keepdim=True)
    91	        for _ in range(iterations):
    92	            q /= q.sum(0, keepdim=True)
    93	            q /= codebook_size
    94	            q /= q.sum(1, keepdim=True)
    95	            q /= batch_size
    96	        q *= batch_size
    97	        return q

    99	    def _distances(self, latent: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   100	        code_embs = self.get_code_embs()
   101	        return (
   102	            latent.pow(2).sum(1, keepdim=True)
   103	            - 2 * latent @ code_embs.t()
   104	            + code_embs.pow(2).sum(1, keepdim=True).t()
   105	        )

   107	    def _indices(self, distances: torch.Tensor, infer_use_sk: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
   108	        if (self.training and self.use_sk) or (self.use_sk and infer_use_sk):
   109	            centered = self.center_distance(distances).double()
   110	            q = self.sinkhorn(centered, self.sk_epsilon, self.sk_iters)
   111	            if torch.isnan(q).any() or torch.isinf(q).any():
   112	                raise RuntimeError("Sinkhorn assignment returned NaN or infinity.")
   113	            return torch.argmax(q, dim=-1)
   114	        return torch.argmin(distances, dim=-1)

   117	        self,
   118	        x: torch.Tensor,
   119	        infer_use_sk: bool = False,
   120	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, int, torch.Tensor]:
   121	        latent = x.view(-1, self.dim)
   122	        embed_ind = self._indices(self._distances(latent), infer_use_sk)
   123	        onehot = F.one_hot(embed_ind, self.n_embed)
   124	        used = onehot.sum(0)
   125	        # Skip the DDP all_reduce when running inference on rank 0 only:
   126	        # the unused-code accounting is a per-rank stat, and a single-rank
   127	        # all_reduce would deadlock waiting for the other 3 ranks to join.
   128	        if distributed.is_initialized() and infer_use_sk is False and not getattr(self, "_skip_ddp_reduce", False):

   130	        unused_codes = int((used == 0).sum().item())
   131	
   132	        x_q = F.embedding(embed_ind, self.get_code_embs()).view(x.shape)
   133	        quant_loss = F.mse_loss(x_q, x.detach()) + self.beta * F.mse_loss(x, x_q.detach())
   134	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()
   135	        return x_q, quant_loss, unused_codes, embed_ind.view(*x.shape[:-1])
   136	
   137	    def embed_code(self, embed_id: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   138	        return F.embedding(embed_id, self.get_code_embs())

   140	    def init_codebook(self, x: torch.Tensor, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
   141	        kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=self.n_embed, n_init="auto").fit(x.detach().cpu().numpy())
   142	        centers = torch.tensor(kmeans.cluster_centers_, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
   143	        if distributed.is_initialized():
   144	            distributed.broadcast(centers, 0)
   145	        self._copy_init_embed(centers.clone())
   146	        embed_ind = torch.argmin(self._distances(x), dim=-1).view(*x.shape[:-1])
   147	        return x - self.embed_code(embed_ind)

   172	    def _copy_init_embed(self, init_embed: torch.Tensor) -> None:
   173	        self.embed.data.copy_(init_embed)
   174	        self.embed_avg.data.copy_(init_embed)

   267	            iterations = self.sk_iters if level == self.codebook_num - 1 else -1

   149	    Q /= sum_Q

   154	        Q /= B
